topic.symptom: The PC is on and the monitor is on, but the monitor shows nothing from the PC.
topic.title: PC On, Monitor Blank? Check the Input Setting

script: PC on, monitor blank? Check which port your cable is in. Open the monitor's input menu. Pick the input that matches your cable. Then check the screen again.

storyboard.title: PC On, Monitor Blank? Check the Input Setting
storyboard.narrationStyle: Calm, conversational, one check. The captions are burned into the cut; no voice generated.

beats.visualDirection: The stylized PC lit, its fans turning; the monitor beside it stays dark.

beats.narration: Check which port your cable is in.
beats.visualDirection: The back of the PC: the display cable sits in the graphics card's ports, outlined amber; EXAMPLE: DISPLAYPORT.
A large monitor, screen dark; a bezel button is pressed and an INPUT SOURCE menu opens with HDMI 1 selected.
beats.onScreenText: INPUT MENU → MENUS VARY BY MONITOR

beats.narration: Pick the input that matches your cable.
beats.visualDirection: Two presses move the selection to DisplayPort; a third confirms it with a green tick.
The camera closes on the monitor beside the lit PC; the screen is still dark. No picture is shown or promised.

factualGuardrails: Never say: guaranteed cure for blank screens (It may not work; one check, never a guaranteed fix.)
Never say: picture instantly appears afterwards (The cut ends on a dark screen; no picture is shown or promised.)
persistentDisclosures: Stylized example · not a fix for every PC
